toegepas.blok: Die skaap, die haan en die eend
toegepas.na: eend nog voor die mense gevlieg
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'voor die mense' can be read as 'in front of the people'; 'nog voor' makes it clearly 'before the people did'.
toegepas.fout: 'voor die mense gevlieg' can be read as 'flew in front of the people', and a crowd did watch, so a Grade 4 reader can take the wrong sense.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'nog voor' fixes the time sense (the animals flew before any person did) without changing who flew or when.

toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans 'massief' means solid, not huge; 'yslik' carries the intended size.
toegepas.fout: 'massief' in Afrikaans means solid, which misdescribes a fabric covering; 'huge' is an English-led sense.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'yslike' gives the intended size plainly and leaves the protected word 'omhulsel' intact.

toegepas.voor: korter as die reis met 'n skip.
toegepas.na: korter as die reis met 'n skip op die see.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson calls the airship 'die skip', so 'met 'n skip' is ambiguous; 'op die see' makes clear a sea ship is meant.
toegepas.fout: The lesson keeps calling the airship 'die skip', so 'die reis met 'n skip' can be read as the airship itself.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'op die see' makes clear a sea ship is meant, fixing the reference without adding a fact.

toegepas.blok: Waarom die groot lugskepe nie meer mense oor die see dra nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'omkom' is the usual verb for dying in a disaster; the protected 'Van die 97 mense aan boord het 35' is untouched.
toegepas.fout: 'in die ramp gesterf' is stiffer than the verb Afrikaans normally uses for dying in a disaster.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'omgekom' is the natural verb here, the meaning is unchanged, and the protected numbers stay untouched.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Een vlam' as 'a single flame' is a calque; ''n enkele vlam' is the natural Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Een vlam naby' is natural Afrikaans already, so the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Waarom die groot lugskepe nie meer mense oor die see dra nie
laat_vaar.voor: was die hele groot skip in vlamme
laat_vaar.na: het die hele groot skip in vlamme gestaan
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'in vlamme staan' is the idiomatic Afrikaans expression; the protected 'Binne minder as 'n minuut' is untouched.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'was die hele groot skip in vlamme' is ordinary, correct Afrikaans that an editor would let pass; the idiom swap is only different.

na_skrywer.voor: vaartuig vol ligte gas wat deur enjins gestoot word
na_skrywer.na: vaartuig wat vol ligte gas is en deur enjins gestoot word
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The relative clause attaches to 'gas', so it reads as if the gas is pushed by engines; the rewrite attaches it to the vessel.
na_skrywer.fout: The relative clause 'wat deur enjins gestoot word' can attach to 'gas' instead of the vessel.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a shared glossary definition reworded beyond grammar, so only the writer may change it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
